integrity: The late-time expansion is proved analytically; 66 finite checks corroborate, but cannot prove infinite-time estimates; no independent validation has been performed.
limitations: For fixed initial site, positive hopping and loss, and a single continuously coupled boundary jump; no uniformity as parameters co-vary; the absorption time has an atom at infinity and the moment statement is conditional on absorption.
title: Sharp late-absorption tail and a weak-sink extremum for a Lindblad half-line quantum walk
